_comment: Sample Cloud Storage lifecycle for the PRIVATE replay bucket (chat-replays). Deletes any object older than 1 day — the terminal replay TTL is 600 s, so a 1-day floor only reaps orphans/leftovers. Firestore logical expiry is authoritative before any read; this lifecycle is cleanup only. Apply to a dedicated smoke bucket only: gcloud storage buckets update gs://<your-replay-bucket> --lifecycle-file=replay-bucket-lifecycle.json
